panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The ancient trees part reluctantly, revealing a clearing choked with amber veins of corruption. At its heart, the Thorn-Ent stirs — a towering fusion of wood and malice, its bark split by pulsing golden rot.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Its roots have drunk deep from whatever taints this land. The corruption here is old — older than the settlements, older than the Crown's maps. It must be purged.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The Thorn-Ent crumbles, its corrupted bark splitting apart like shattered pottery. Where it fell, green light breaks through the canopy for the first time in years.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: Among the remains, a crystalline shard pulses with fading energy. Whatever force animated the Ent — it came from somewhere deeper. This was merely a symptom.

panels.speaker: Narrator
panels.text: The Thorn-Ent's roots surge forward, dragging the fallen heroes beneath the corrupted soil. The forest reclaims its own. The corruption endures.
